identity: Two checkpointed extraq slots: unique integer ID and per-step sparse selection; count plus mixed-ID sum/xor checked after each MPI migration
sparse_capture: Cells with start count<=4; all node-sharing neighbors, including MPI neighbors, added only for steps 81..105; selection travels with particles

path_columns.PATH: step stage id host_before dt old_xyz[3] raw_trial_xyz[3] bounded_trial_xyz[3] raw_velocity[3] [stage1:gradient_valid dv_i_dx_j[9] h_halving_discrepancy]

gradient: Central Cartesian finite difference h=min_edge*1e-4 and h/2 of production interpolant; samples crossing host boundaries omitted and counted; no claim of pointwise Stokes divergence

replay.mesh: native int32 header magic PMM1, rank, cap, nno, nel, elx, elz; five float64 ri,ro,cushion,theta_f,phi_f; spherical coordinates 3*nno float64; connectivity 8*nel int32
replay.velocity: native int32 magic PMV1,rank,step,nno; float64 time/dt; spherical velocities 3*nno float32
replay.tool: tests/pices/build_motion_replay.py links real MPI tracer mover, frozen nodal field, no Stokes/TA/heat advancement; subdivisions 1/2/4
replay.production_replays: Not submitted automatically. Select event/state after capture audit. Different MPI decomposition requires a separate manufactured initial-state test, not a same-partition checkpoint restart.

cost.extra_checkpoints: Two complete global states; retained on HPC along with mesh and velocity files. Archive excludes these large replay inputs.

diagnostic_on_off.interpretation: observational capture validated; frozen-field convergence and alternative MPI decomposition still require replay

limits: No production cause attribution before HPC evidence
ID signatures are probabilistic integrity checks; sparse trace pairing rejects duplicate/missing IDs exactly within recorded paths
No insertion/deletion or numerical correction is applied
Runtime velocity snapshots capture a narrow window, not all 300 steps
